name: @usemcpkit/video
description: The 30-second mcpkit promo, made with Remotion.

scripts.render: yarn audio && remotion render Promo build/mcpkit.video.mp4
scripts.pages: yarn audio && rm -rf build/pages && remotion render Promo build/pages/mcpkit.mp4 && remotion still Promo build/pages/poster.jpg --frame=1900 --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=90 && cp site/index.html build/pages/index.html
